capabilities.description: Ingests the uploaded Harbourline contract and BOQ, extracts and version-pins the governing terms (Clause 8.2 Time for Completion, 8.7 Delay Damages, 11.1 DNP, 14.3 Retention, 4.2 Performance Security) and the BOQ item/rate schedule, and makes that pinned set the authority every other capability read

Builds Interim Payment Certificates from measured BOQ quantities and rates, applies 5% retention per Clause 14.3, and tracks release of 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period.

Monitors elapsed time against the 730-day Time for Completion from the Commencement Date, projects taking-over dates, and computes delay-damages exposure at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day capped at 10%, with early-warning notifications as the cap is approached.

Holds the Inspection and Test Plan register and inspection records against BOQ work items, capturing hold points, witness points, sign-offs and evidence so QA status can be cited in claims and taking-over submissions.

Maintains the project document register: incoming and outgoing correspondence, drawings, submittals, transmittals and contract instructions, each with revision control, distribution and a tamper-evident audit trail.

Gates each claim, notification and taking-over submission against the pinned contract clauses and BOQ schedule, refusing or escalating records that conflict with Time for Completion, retention, security or DNP terms.
